create_timestamp_aligner: create a TimestampAligner with a specified lag to buffer and align messages from multiple streams
register_callback_on_aligner: register a callback function on a TimestampAligner for a specific stream id
push_message_to_aligner: push a timestamped message into the aligner buffer using LabgraphCallbackParams
get_aligned_messages: retrieve and deliver aligned messages from the buffer after the lag period has elapsed
run_aligner_loop: run the TimestampAligner async loop to continuously deliver aligned messages until termination
